cases.name: Martha Elizabeth Young
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Martha was a wonderful and loving mother to her four beautiful daughters. She enjoyed reading, music and being outdoors. She was very creative and enjoyed practicing Holistic and Reiki healing. She joined the United States Army in 2008 and served her country until 2009. She worked as a phlebotomist for several years."
